steps.text: A calculator with only ONE working button! Reach the target using just it.
Tap “+1,000” again and again to climb toward the target.
When you hit the target, tap “Check”.
Count smart: target ÷ 1,000 tells you exactly how many taps you need.

coach.mission: Reach the target using only the +1,000 button.
whenStuck: Target ÷ 1,000 tells you how many taps you need.
whenWrong: Count the taps: target ÷ 1,000 is the exact number of presses. You may be one short or over.
Use place value — each press adds one to the thousands place.
whenCorrect: You worked out the taps from place value.
coach.done: You've mastered the restricted calculator. Keep going, or move on.
